title: Find the number occurring an odd number of times
summary: A reconciliation batch contains pairs of matching identifiers and one identifier with an odd count. Find the value that occurs an odd number of times. Identify the integer occurring an odd number of times.
requirements: Input has at most one value with an odd occurrence count.
Negative values and zero are allowed.
hints: Track how often each number occurs.
An odd count leaves remainder one when divided by two.
